semantics: Captures commonInfo and cache.data before try.
Awaits api.getSettingFileInfo({}).

If commonInfo.userInfo.loginMode !== Dcm51.NETWORK_STATUS.ONLINE (1), constructs {errorStatus:Dcm51.ERROR_STATUS.NETWORK_ERROR} with errorStatus=1 and returns Promise.reject(ret). This returned rejection is not awaited inside try, so the local catch does not unwrap it.

Otherwise awaits api.getVin({}); then writes cacheData.settingData.sendIccid.url=ret_getSettingFileInfo.sendIccid.url, id=ret_getSettingFileInfo.sendIccid.serverId, and cacheData.vin=ret_vin.vin, in that order; returns Promise.resolve({}).
Catch returns Promise.reject(e.result).
branches: Setting retrieval failure takes precedence over the offline check.
Offline skips VIN retrieval and all three cache writes.
Any caught error is unwrapped through .result without normalization; ordinary errors may therefore become undefined rejections.
methods.effects_and_cleanup: No communication begins here. No URL, server ID or VIN content validation beyond worker behavior.

semantics: Captures cache.data and initializes ret_iccid=''.
Outer try awaits api.startGeneralComm({}), then api.startExtendedSession({}).
Inner try awaits api.readIccid({}). Inner catch awaits api.endExtendedSession({}), then throws the original error if cleanup resolves.

After successful read, awaits api.endExtendedSession({}), then api.endGeneralComm({}); only afterward assigns cacheData.iccid=ret_iccid.iccid and cacheData.imei=ret_iccid.imei, and returns Promise.resolve({}).
Outer catch awaits api.endGeneralComm({}), then returns Promise.reject(e.result).
branches: startGeneralComm failure still leads to an endGeneralComm call.
startExtendedSession failure skips endExtendedSession and leads directly to endGeneralComm.
Read failure attempts endExtendedSession before outer endGeneralComm.
A rejection from inner cleanup replaces the original read failure. A rejection from success-path endGeneralComm causes a second endGeneralComm attempt in outer catch.
A rejection from the outer catch's endGeneralComm escapes directly, bypassing e.result unwrapping.
methods.effects_and_cleanup: No finally is used. Identifier cache writes occur only after both success-path cleanup awaits. Actual worker cleanup methods swallow their common API promise rejections, but constructor or other uncaught failures can still reject.

methods.semantics: Captures cache.data. Catch returns Promise.reject(e.result).
branches: Any resolved worker result is accepted; no frontend response-field predicate.
methods.effects_and_cleanup: No cache mutation or retries; caught rejection is unwrapped by .result.

semantics: Creates GtsPFApi before try; captures commonInfo and initializes settingFileInfo={sendIccid:{url:'',serverId:null}}.

Try awaits nested getSettingFile(), then returns nested createReturnValue(). Catch discards the error and rejects {result:{errorStatus:Dcm51.ERROR_STATUS.SETTING_FILE_ERROR}}, numerically {result:{errorStatus:4}}.
getSettingFile reads commonInfo.settingFileInfo.distributorDepending.countryInformation.userType.filePath and calls gtsPFApi.getSettingFileInfo({filePath:userTypeSettingPath,keyList:['sendIccid']}).

Its then callback tests response.apiArgs.fileData for truthiness. If truthy, calls gts.util.parseSettingResponse(response.apiArgs.fileData,gts.util.SettingType.OBJECT), then assigns settingFileInfo={sendIccid:{url:responseData.sendIccidRequest_url ?? '',serverId:responseData.id ?? ''}} and resolves. Falsy fileData rejects without a value.
The nested catch rejects without a value, discarding any API/parse/callback error. createReturnValue returns Promise.resolve(settingFileInfo).
branches: Null/undefined URL or id become ''; other falsy values, including 0 and false, are preserved by ??.
No nonempty URL/serverId validation; successful parsing with absent properties can return empty strings.
GtsPFApi construction is outside try and is not mapped by this catch.

Outer catch rejects {result:{errorStatus:Dcm51.ERROR_STATUS.VIN_ERROR}}, numerically {result:{errorStatus:2}}.
branches: Short strings are space-padded; strings longer than 17 are not truncated.
An empty string is padded and accepted. No VIN character/registration check is implemented.
Missing/non-padEnd-capable vin or API rejection is mapped through the catch; constructor failure is outside try.
methods.effects_and_cleanup: Returns the padded value only; no worker cache write.

semantics: Initializes iccid='' and imei=''. Try awaits sendMessageyReadIccid(), assigns its result, then awaits sendMessageyReadImei(), assigns its result, and returns createReturnValue(). Catch rejects {result:{errorStatus:Dcm51.ERROR_STATUS.COM_ERROR}}, numerically {result:{errorStatus:0}}.

sendMessageyReadIccid calls gts.util.SendMessageForUtility({reqType:0,reqBody:[0x22,0x10,0x18]}). Its then computes dataPart=response.apiArgs.resBody.slice(3). If dataPart.length < 20 it rejects. Otherwise uses dataPart.slice(0,20), asciiIccid='', isOutOfRange=false, and iterates i from 0 while i < iccidInDataPart.length.

For each ICCID byte: exactly 0x00 breaks immediately; otherwise 0x30 <= byte && byte <= 0x39 appends String.fromCharCode(byte); otherwise sets isOutOfRange=true and breaks. After the loop, isOutOfRange rejects; otherwise resolves asciiIccid. Its catch rejects without a value.

sendMessageyReadImei calls gts.util.SendMessageForUtility({reqType:0,reqBody:[0x22,0x10,0x1A]}). Its then computes dataPart=response.apiArgs.resBody.slice(3). If dataPart.length < 15 it rejects. Otherwise uses dataPart.slice(0,15), asciiImei='', isOutOfRange=false, and iterates i from 0 while i < imeiInDataPart.length.

For each IMEI byte: 0x30 <= byte && byte <= 0x39 appends String.fromCharCode(byte); anything else sets isOutOfRange=true and breaks. After the loop, isOutOfRange rejects; otherwise resolves asciiImei. Its catch rejects without a value.
createReturnValue resolves {iccid:iccid,imei:imei}.
branches: ICCID failure prevents the IMEI request.
ICCID requires at least 20 data bytes even when a zero terminator is early. A zero first byte accepts an empty ICCID. Bytes after the first zero within the 20-byte window are not validated.
ICCID without a zero terminator accepts exactly 20 digit bytes.
IMEI has no zero-termination allowance and requires all first 15 data bytes to be digits.
Additional bytes beyond the respective 20/15 windows are ignored. The first three response bytes are discarded without local validation.
All caught request, slicing or conversion failures map to COM_ERROR (0).

resource_binding.presentation_source: Unit view/dialog methods construct inline DOM or supply typed content/button/table parameters to shared UtilityView/createCommonDialog; no external workflow HTML template path is referenced by these members. Exact inline HTML and options are preserved in source evidence.

entry_admission.initialization: Seat05Controller.init constructs model, dialog, and view, then returns worker initialization followed by title logging and mode-screen display. A rejected initialization does not display the screen and has no local recovery.
entry_admission.vehicle_condition: Engine/power ON with Engine OFF/Ready OFF is an operator instruction, not a programmatic admission predicate.
entry_admission.mode_selection: DEFAULT=0 initially disables Next; SEAT_BACK=1 and CUSHION=2 are the radio values. Next converts the supplied event value with Number and stores it without validation.
entry_admission.start: Start is initially disabled and checkbox clicks enable it at one or more document-wide checked inputs. The controller independently enforces neither a positive count nor the four-item limit, mode membership, vehicle condition, or bladder availability.
entry_admission.worker_installation: Local worker installation occurs only when workerController.workerModels['Seat05'] is falsy. Runtime initialization must precede use of commonInfo and cache.

modes.validation: The model setter accepts any value. All seat-back/cushion choices use strict equality with numeric 1 and otherwise choose cushion. Number(evt.args[1][0].value) can produce values outside the declared modes, including NaN.

input_domain.events: Next consumes evt.args[1][0].value. Start consumes evt.args[1] as entries with value and domId, selecting truthy value entries in their original order. Dialog callbacks consume pressed.id; the cancellation deferred resolves scalar 'Yes' or 'No'.
input_domain.checkbox_ids: Seat-back IDs are r_item_i7092 through r_item_i7101; cushion IDs are r_item_i7105 through r_item_i7112. Unknown and duplicate IDs are not rejected. Exact contribution maps are retained in the Start method contract.
input_domain.communication: Worker commands consume param.parameter. Startup consumes ecuId, selectedMode, selectedCheckBoxValue; results consume selectedMode. Polling consumes response.apiArgs.resBody or error.response.apiArgs.resBody with the exact optional-chain and rejection behavior recorded below.
input_domain.shared_event_dispatch: The available shared EventDispatcher permits undefined event types and uses the same coerced property for registration and triggering. An absent event constant does not by itself prevent delivery; do not replace shared-owner dispatch semantics with an inferred event-value admission rule.

state_fields.controller: commonInfo; eventDisp; activityReport; model, cmnDlg, and view initially null. Each Start invocation separately captures selectedMode and dialog004PromiseObj initially null, plus selection maps and lists; there is no reentrancy guard.
state_fields.model: commonInfo; selectedMode initialized and reset to DEFAULT=0; api constructed as new Seat05WorkerApi() without commonInfo.
state_fields.dialog: eventDisp and currentModalDialog initially null; creation replaces a truthy modal through closeDialog.
state_fields.view: eventDisp, $viewPane=$('#v_pane'), $ctrlPane=$('#v_c_pane'); UtilityView instances and fresh checkbox DOM are constructed per rendering.
state_fields.worker: commonInfo=null, commandHandler={}, cache=null, commandThread=null at construction. init also assigns ecuCache. initSeat05 replaces cache with {data:{cancelFlg:false}}; startup clears cancelFlg and cancellation sets it true.

guarded_ordered_transitions: init fulfillment -> title log -> mode selection; init rejection propagates without local screen display.
Next -> Number(event value) -> store mode -> bladder selection. Back -> mode selection retaining mode. Strict mode===1 selects seat back; every other value selects cushion.
Checkbox click -> document-wide checked count -> disable unchecked inputs at count>=4 -> disable Start at count<1. Controller Start does not repeat either admission check.
Start -> truthy selection extraction -> resource-name log -> DL002 -> ECU/mode reads -> byte-contribution construction -> detached startup chain.

Worker startup -> clear cancel flag -> ECU bus lookup -> startGeneralComm -> negative-response condition with rejection swallowed -> session 1 -> session 3 -> mode-specific conversion -> initial send. Protected setup failure cleans up without session transition; protected send failure cleans up with session 1; conversion failure bypasses cleanup.

Startup fulfillment -> close wait -> processing DL003 -> await result polling. Each admitted polling iteration waits 50 milliseconds before sending. Body[2]===0x21 or 0x24 with length>=3 repeats; all other bodies terminate polling.
Normal loop return -> classify body -> await session-1/end cleanup -> reasonless rejection for REJECT=-1 or fulfillment with 0/1. Exceptions in the loop or classification bypass this cleanup.
Cancel -> DL004 deferred decision. Yes -> DL002 -> await worker flag-setting -> resolve scalar Yes. No -> reopen DL003 -> resolve scalar No -> clear stored decision.

Result success or main catch -> await any stored decision. Yes -> close modal and emit backToUtilityMenu, suppressing ordinary result/error handling. Otherwise status===0 logs success and closes; other fulfilled statuses offer retry; rejection closes, awaits inherited communication error, then shows mode selection.
Retry Yes -> mode selection; retry No -> navigation event; unexpected retry IDs -> no action. Exit Yes -> navigation event; other exit IDs -> no action.
dispose -> clear view and control panes -> dispose view dispatcher -> hide title -> dispose controller dispatcher -> fulfilled promise; no explicit activity cancellation or communication teardown.

request_construction.frontend: Exact model objects are {}, {ecuId,selectedMode,selectedCheckBoxValue}, {selectedMode}, and {} for initialization, startup, result, and cancellation respectively. API send uses the command strings retained per method; worker handlers consume the transport envelope param.parameter.
request_construction.contribution_mapping: See Seat05Controller.prototype.onClickSSeat05002003StartBtn.semantics.mapping. Map each selected ID separately into each byte map, preserving order and dropping falsy contributions without deduplication, mode filtering, or count checks.
request_construction.arithmetic: Sums use JavaScript addition, not bitwise OR; no masking, range checks, deduplication, or byte normalization.
request_construction.native_setup: startGeneralComm({ecuId,busId}); setNegativeResponseCondition({repReqRetryMax:0}); transitSession({modeId:1}); transitSession({modeId:3}), awaited in that order.
request_construction.cleanup: new GtsPFApi(); optionally transitSession({modeId:1}), then endGeneralComm() without arguments. Chained promise rejections are swallowed.

response_error_mapping.startup: Initial send fulfillment is sufficient; no response fields are inspected. Protected setup or send failure awaits its cleanup variant and rejects without a reason unless cleanup itself throws/rejects outside its swallowing paths.
response_error_mapping.polling: Send rejection is transformed by catch(error=>error.response). Read sendMessageResponse?.apiArgs.resBody ?? []; optional chaining protects only a nullish sendMessageResponse, not missing apiArgs on a non-null response. A nullish rejection value can throw in error.response.
response_error_mapping.retry: length>=3 and element 2 strictly equal to 0x21 or 0x24 repeats, with no retry count or timeout. No additional header validation is performed.
response_error_mapping.status: length<6 or element 5 neither 0x02 nor 0x03 -> REJECT=-1; element 5===0x02 -> NORMAL_END=0; element 5===0x03 -> ABNORMAL_END=1. Cleanup precedes reasonless rejection or status fulfillment.
response_error_mapping.controller: The startup .catch also catches errors from the returned async success callback, including result rejection. A confirmed cancellation overrides ordinary handling. Otherwise it closes the modal, awaits showCommErrorDialog(), then shows mode selection. Errors in that catch have no later local catch.
response_error_mapping.detached_callbacks: Exit, processing Cancel, stop confirmation, and retry button callbacks are not returned into the main chain. Cancellation-command rejection can leave its decision deferred unresolved. Synchronous preparation errors precede the main chain.

mutation_cleanup_cancel_semantics.selection: Mode remains stored across Back and retry screen rendering; init resets it to 0. Each bladder screen creates fresh unchecked inputs.
mutation_cleanup_cancel_semantics.cancellation: Only cache.data.cancelFlg is changed; no separate native stop or abort is issued. Cancellation during wait/send does not prevent the current iteration's request or response evaluation. A Yes decision remains stored, while No resolves then clears it. Result handling waits for an outstanding decision, allowing races and unresolved-decision stalls.
mutation_cleanup_cancel_semantics.communication: Successful startup leaves communication open for polling. Setup failure invokes _endGeneralComm(false); initial-send failure and ordinary result return invoke _endGeneralComm(true). Pre-try errors, conversion errors, and exceptional polling paths have no finally cleanup.
mutation_cleanup_cancel_semantics.modal: Every dialog creation closes a truthy existing modal before replacement. closeDialog calls close() before nulling the reference; an exception prevents null assignment. Auto-close and pending button-promise treatment are common-owned.
mutation_cleanup_cancel_semantics.disposal: See controller.dispose and view.disposeView. Neither explicitly closes dialogs, cancels polling, disposes the model/worker, ends communication, nor locally unbinds document-wide checkbox handlers.
mutation_cleanup_cancel_semantics.promise_ownership: Controller init, model/API forwarding, and worker operations return their documented promises. Start returns undefined despite creating a .then(async...).catch(async...) chain; nested button callbacks are detached and generally lack recovery.

business_sequence: The unit presents Refresh Bladder Activation Check. The initial instructions ask the operator to confirm that the engine/power switch is ON with Engine OFF/Ready OFF, then select Seat back or Cushion. This condition is instructional text, not a programmatically checked admission rule.

Controller initialization constructs the model, dialog owner, and view, awaits worker initialization, logs the title, and displays the mode-selection screen. Worker initialization sets cache.data.cancelFlg=false. Seat05.SELECTED_MODE is frozen with DEFAULT=0, SEAT_BACK=1, and CUSHION=2.

The mode-selection view initially disables Next only when selectedMode strictly equals Seat05.SELECTED_MODE.DEFAULT, numeric 0. Next reads Number(evt.args[1][0].value), stores that value without validation, and opens the bladder-selection screen. Back restores mode selection using the stored mode.

The bladder-selection view uses the seat-back configuration only for strict equality with Seat05.SELECTED_MODE.SEAT_BACK, numeric 1; all other values use the cushion configuration. The instructions allow up to four bladders and warn that availability varies by car model. A document-wide checkbox click handler disables unchecked checkboxes at four or more checked items and enables Start at one or more. The controller does not independently enforce these limits.

Start selects truthy checkbox values, preserves their order, logs their resource names by implicit array-to-string conversion, displays Please wait, retrieves the current ECU ID and selected mode, maps checkbox IDs to exact byte contribution arrays, and requests worker startup.

The worker clears its cancellation flag, obtains busId from commonInfo using ecuId, starts general communication, attempts to configure repReqRetryMax:0 while swallowing that call's rejection, then awaits sessions modeId:1 and modeId:3 in order. Setup failure invokes communication cleanup without a session-1 transition and rejects. Successful setup converts the selected contributions to a request and awaits SendMessageForUtility; a send rejection invokes cleanup with a session-1 transition and rejects.

After startup fulfills, the controller closes the wait dialog, opens the processing dialog with Cancel, and awaits result polling. The worker waits 50 milliseconds before each request [0x31,0x03,0x02,rid], where rid is 0x60 for seat back and 0x61 otherwise. Polling continues only while cancellation is false and the returned body has at least three elements with element 2 equal to 0x21 or 0x24.

A result body shorter than six elements, or with element 5 neither 0x02 nor 0x03, maps to REJECT=-1. Element 5 equal to 0x02 maps to NORMAL_END=0; 0x03 maps to ABNORMAL_END=1. The worker awaits cleanup before rejecting REJECT without a reason or fulfilling another status. It performs no additional response-header validation.

Normal completion logs This utility is successful and closes the modal, leaving the bladder-selection screen in place. A non-normal fulfilled status opens the failure/retry dialog; Yes returns to mode selection, No emits backToUtilityMenu, and other IDs do nothing.

Cancel opens a stop-confirmation dialog and creates a deferred decision promise. Yes replaces it with Please wait, awaits setting the worker cancellation flag, then resolves the decision as Yes. No reopens processing, resolves No, and clears the stored decision reference. Cancellation does not issue a separate native stop request; the shown worker mechanism only changes the flag read by the polling loop.

Both the result-success callback and its catch path await a non-null cancellation decision before ordinary completion handling. A Yes decision closes the current modal and emits backToUtilityMenu instead of logging success, showing retry, or showing communication error. Otherwise the catch closes the modal, awaits the inherited communication-error dialog, and returns to mode selection.

Exit on either ordinary screen asks whether to exit and emits backToUtilityMenu only for pressed.id equal to Yes. Controller disposal clears view/control panes, disposes the view and controller event dispatchers, and hides the title. It does not explicitly close dialogs, cancel polling, dispose the model/worker, or stop communication.

business_sequence: The utility configures Key Lock-In Prevention Function (Battery Remove) and the auxiliary-battery position. Authoritative frozen constants are KEY_LOCK_PREVENTION_FUNCTION_STATE={DISABLE:0,ENABLE:1}, BATTERY_POSITION={ENGINE_OR_MOTOR_COMPARTMENT:1,LUGGAGE_COMPARTMENT:2}, and PROCESSING_RESULTS={SUCCESS:0,FAILURE:1}.

Initialization constructs the frontend model, dialog provider and view provider, obtains commonInfo.getCurrentEcuId(), and awaits worker initialization with {ecuId}. The worker caches only ecuId and busId from commonInfo.getEcuInfoByEcuId(ecuId), plus empty preservation arrays. This initialization precedes the controller's try/catch and therefore is not covered by its communication-error recovery.

After worker initialization, the controller logs the utility title, creates an empty initial view and a buttonless Please wait dialog, and reads the function state and battery position. The initial view is assigned to currentview, not currentView. Initial worker reading starts communication, requests sessions 1 then 3, reads [0x22,0x22,0x16] and [0x22,0x22,0xC0], then performs communication cleanup. Local read validation checks only resBody.length >= 4.

A successful initial read updates frontend memSts and memPos, closes the wait dialog, and displays the introduction. A failed read can update memSts alone before rejection; the controller closes the wait dialog, awaits inherited showCommErrorDialog(), and triggers backToUtilityMenu. No native completion is asserted by this contract.

The introduction tells the operator to confirm engine/power switch ON with Engine OFF/Ready OFF. Next displays a second explanation: opening the hood/back door at the battery location automatically enables the manual-release handle, may cause a door-lock sound, and enabling this function requires configuring the battery position. These are resource instructions, not programmatic admission checks.

Next displays current function state and an Enable/Disable radio selection, with numeric radio values 1/0. The Next button is initially disabled and requests parameters from the shared UtilityView. The handler uses parseInt(param.args[1][0].value,10), opens the wait dialog, logs Selected radio button: followed directly by the selected resource text, then requests a write and readback. No local range check or click-in-progress guard is present.

Function writing preserves trailing bytes captured from the initial function read: [0x2E,0x22,0x16,screen004selectedValue,...cacheData.memStsOthersData]. It waits 200 before writing and 200 before readback. Readback must strictly equal the selected value. Disable=0 proceeds directly to the disabled completion screen; Enable=1 reads battery position and preserves its trailing bytes for the subsequent battery write.

After a successful function-setting result, the controller branches on the model's resulting memSts, not directly on the selected value. Disable logs This utility is successful, closes the wait dialog and displays completion with Set value is Disable. Enable closes the wait dialog and displays battery configuration. An unrecognized resulting state has no switch default, leaving the wait dialog open.

Battery configuration displays the stored battery position or No Information, offers Engine/Motor Compartment and Luggage Compartment, initially disables parameterized Next, and explicitly disables the DOM Exit button. The controller registers only Next on this screen. The handler parses the same nested event value, logs the selection, and writes [0x2E,0x22,0xC0,screen005selectedValue,...cacheData.memPosOthersData], with 200 waits before write and readback. Readback must strictly equal the selected value.

Successful battery configuration updates memPos, logs This utility is successful, closes the wait dialog and displays battery-location completion. Its text instructs the operator, after IG OFF, to open the hood/back door at the battery location and check outside manual-release operation. Those physical checks are not implemented or verified by this code.

Failures during either setting workflow close the wait dialog, await inherited showCommErrorDialog(), and return to the introduction. Worker-returned FAILURE may first update the corresponding non-null partial frontend value. Unexpected processingResults values are not rejected by the frontend model; they resolve undefined without updates.

Exit from introduction, explanation or function selection opens a Yes/No confirmation. State is captured when the confirmation opens. Yes exits unless captured memSts is ENABLE=1 and captured memPos is neither 1 nor 2. That inconsistent state opens a warning requiring Auxiliary Battery Position Configuration; its Ok result returns to the introduction. No leaves the existing screen. Completion-screen Exit directly triggers backToUtilityMenu.

Communication cleanup is explicit try/catch sequencing, not finally. It optionally requests session 1 and always requests endGeneralComm({}); each of those shared API rejections is swallowed inside its cleanup helper. Read and function-write operations set the cleanup session flag only after extended-session success; battery-write initializes that flag true before communication starts. There is no polling, recurring timer, timer-clear operation, native cancellation command, or disposal-based cancellation in this unit.

entry_admission.initialization: Ars07Controller.init constructs the model, view factory, and dialog factory before its try, initializes the selected ECU cache, logs the resource title, and returns initial-screen creation. Its catch reads onErrorCommon without invoking it.

entry_admission.completion: The manual-adjustment view's NEXT_BTN registration admits completion without locally checking Toe Control Rod assembly, adjustment, switch state, or ECU success.

entry_admission.event_delivery: Shared event registration and delivery belong to diagnostic_operations.frontend_contracts.MenuShell. EventDispatcher permits undefined event types through the same coerced property key; an undefined event type does not, by itself, prevent delivery.

mutation_cleanup_cancel_semantics.cancellation: Initial Next writes false; progress Cancel writes true before closing the progress loader and showing the wait loader. The progress handler is detached. Polling tests the captured cacheData.isCancel only at iteration entry and does not abort an in-flight wait/send.
mutation_cleanup_cancel_semantics.races: Cancellation during a wait/send can lose to a same-iteration success. Cache replacement during polling does not replace the captured cacheData reference. No repeated-click lock serializes frontend handlers.
mutation_cleanup_cancel_semantics.cleanup: Exact cleanup ordering and catch coverage are retained in business_sequence and member_contracts. Model.endGeneralComm independently attempts stopKeepAlive and then endGeneralComm, swallowing each failure.

mutation_cleanup_cancel_semantics.disposal: Controller.dispose only calls currentView.disposeView() and eventDisp.dispose(), with no null guard, polling cancellation, dialog closure, communication teardown, or model disposal.
mutation_cleanup_cancel_semantics.timers: No local timer handle, clear operation, abort, or independent deadline exists.

business_sequence: The unit implements the Rear Toe Adjustment frontend workflow. Resource instructions describe physical preconditions, but this code does not measure or enforce them: engine/power switch ON with Engine OFF/Ready OFF, vehicle lifted, and no people or objects touching the rear steering mechanism. Admission to adjustment is the initial view's Next event; no local debounce, busy flag, or condition validation is present.

Controller initialization constructs the model, view factory, and dialog factory using commonInfo, initializes the worker cache for commonInfo.getCurrentEcuId(), logs the title 'Rear Toe Adjustment', and displays the initial instructions. Initialization failure merely evaluates controller.onErrorCommon without invoking it.

Initial Next displays the buttonless 'Please wait.' loader, writes cancellation false, starts general communication and keep-alive, then transits to default session before requesting extended session. It starts neutral-position adjustment using reqType 0 and reqBody [0x2E,0x20,0x20,0x01].

After the adjustment-start promise fulfills, the controller closes the loader, invokes the cancellable progress dialog without awaiting its promise, records Date.now(), and starts the worker's read loop with that timer. The progress dialog says 'Neutral Position Adjustment in progress.\nPlease wait.' Cancel writes cancellation true, closes the progress loader, and displays the buttonless wait loader; interruption and communication teardown are performed later by the polling rejection path.

Polling checks cacheData.isCancel === true before each iteration, then awaits 200 ms and sends {reqType:0,reqBody:[0x22,0x10,0x22]}. A response shorter than four bytes fails. Fourth byte 0x02 succeeds. Any fourth byte other than 0x01 fails. Fourth byte 0x01 continues only while Date.now() - timer < 10000. Exceptions fail. Cancellation is distinguished by rejection {result:{isCancelCheck:true}}; all other polling failures reject with isCancelCheck false.

Successful neutral-position polling closes the progress loader, displays the wait loader, transits back to default session, closes the loader, and displays the manual toe-adjustment instructions. General communication and keep-alive remain active across that screen.

Cancellation detected by polling sends interruption bytes [0x2E,0x20,0x20,0xFF], transits to default session, stops keep-alive, ends general communication, closes the loader, and recreates the initial screen. A non-cancellation polling failure first replaces the progress loader with the wait loader, performs the same interruption/session/communication cleanup, closes the loader, and displays the failure dialog. Other adjustment-stage failures and initial communication-stage failures use distinct nested catch paths described below.

The second screen states neutral-position adjustment is completed, tells the user to assemble and adjust the Toe Control Rod if removed, warns not to turn OFF the engine/power switch during adjustment, and asks for Next after confirming switch ON with Engine OFF/Ready OFF. Next shows the wait loader, requests default then extended session, sends completion bytes [0x2E,0x20,0x20,0x03], and requests default session. Its catch is empty and its finally awaits general-communication cleanup. It then closes the loader and shows the completion screen even when failures were swallowed.

The completion screen says rear toe adjustment is completed, instructs the user to check for no DTC and cycle the engine/power switch OFF and ON, and warns to redo adjustment if power was turned OFF before completion. Exit logs 'This utility is successful' and triggers backToUtilityMenu; this log is a frontend action, not proof of native or ECU success.

Initial Exit opens a Yes/No confirmation. Yes triggers backToUtilityMenu and No resolves without navigation. Disposal only disposes the current view and controller dispatcher; it does not cancel polling, close dialogs, stop keep-alive, end communication, or dispose the model.

response_error_mapping.certification: Hncom01.RESULT is Object.freeze({SUCCESS:0,FAILURE:1}). Only strict numeric-zero result admits setup; every other result value takes DL006, while thrown/rejected processing takes communication-error handling.
response_error_mapping.slope_reads: 1282 requires length >=4 and yields Number.parseFloat((payload[0]*2-160)/100).toFixed(1). Optional 1280 requires length >=4 and yields (payload[0]-100).toString(); its established promise-chain failure yields ''. 1B62 requires length >=5 and yields numeric 1 iff (payload[1]&0x80)===0x80, otherwise 0. Each payload is resBody.slice(3). Mandatory read failures reject without reason and reset the aggregate list.
response_error_mapping.learning_start: Length >=5 admits extraction from resBody.slice(4)[0]; worker returns the extracted element without success interpretation. Controller accepts only ===0x00. Worker failures reset comResult to null and reject without reason.
response_error_mapping.learning_poll: Length >=5 and payload=resBody.slice(3); (payload[1]&0x80)===0x80 maps to numeric 1, otherwise 0. Failure resets local comResult and rejects without reason.
response_error_mapping.learning_stop: Every fulfilled transport response is accepted without inspection; rejection is converted to reasonless rejection.
response_error_mapping.session: Start ignores fulfillment values, swallows established keep-alive promise rejection only, and otherwise rejects without reason inside its try. End swallows each established API promise rejection individually, but synchronous helper/API failures may reject and prevent later cleanup.
response_error_mapping.controller_error_details: The per-method branches preserve try boundaries, repeated cleanup attempts, detached promises and the distinct navigation behavior of communication-error paths.

business_sequence: This unit presents Slope 0 Point Adjustment. The controller constructs its local model, view factory and dialog factory, logs the title resolved from r_item_i6358, initializes the worker cache using commonInfo.getCurrentEcuId(), and only after initialization fulfills displays the initial screen. Initialization rejection is passed to inherited onErrorCommon, without a local recovery implementation.

The initial screen has three blank values: Slope 0 point adjustment value in G, Slope 0 point learning state without a unit, and Gradient (AT only) in %. Start setup and Exit are enabled; Next is disabled. The explanation is 'This function performs zero gradient point adjustment.' Start setup opens the Please wait loader, starts communication/session setup, and then calls the separately owned tool-certification workflow.

Session setup requests startGeneralComm with the cached ecuId and busId, attempts startKeepAlive with {}, and requests transitSession with modeId 3, in that order. A keep-alive rejection is deliberately swallowed; startGeneralComm or transitSession rejection rejects session setup without worker-side rollback. The controller attempts endExtendSession on a setup/certification/read failure.

Only resultCertification.result === Hncom01.RESULT.SUCCESS admits the first slope-status read. The corrected authoritative definition is Hncom01.RESULT=Object.freeze({SUCCESS:0,FAILURE:1}); success therefore requires exact numeric 0. A nonmatching certification result ends the session, closes the loader and displays the security-unlock error. Its OK completion has no navigation callback action. A successful certification leads to sequential reads of 1282, 1280 and 1B62. Failure of the optional 1280 read produces an empty string and continues; failure of either other read rejects the aggregate read.

The setup screen displays those status values and enables Next and Setup complete. Its explanation says Next starts adjustment and warns against shaking. Its Notice says this involves a server connection and requires being online, and asks the user to confirm a level vehicle, engine off, neutral gear, engaged parking brake, no fault codes, and unpressed accelerator and clutch pedals. These are instructional resources, not locally evaluated admission predicates.

Next opens the loader and sends requestStartLearning with reqType 0 and reqBody [49,1,17,3]. Only returned comResult === 0x00 admits polling. On that exact result the controller records Date.now(), closes the loader and starts the learning screen asynchronously without awaiting its returned promise. Any other result ends the session, closes the loader and shows the adjustment-failed dialog. A request exception similarly ends the session and closes the loader, but shows the inherited communication-error dialog and returns to the initial screen when its promise fulfills.

The learning screen keeps the prior slope adjustment and gradient values, displays 'Studying.' and the notice that the buzzer will sound upon completion, and disables Next and Setup complete. No controller button listeners are attached to this screen. While Date.now() - startLearningRequestDatetime <= 10000, the controller awaits readLearningStatus, updates the learning-state cell, and accepts only comResult === 1 as completion. Otherwise it awaits gts.util.wait(500) before evaluating the loop condition again. This is an awaited loop, not a local setInterval/setTimeout registration. A read that begins within the time window can finish outside it and still be accepted as successful.

On detected completion, the controller awaits requestStopLearning, rereads all slope statuses, stores the resulting slopeStatusList, awaits endExtendSession, logs 'This utility is successful', and displays the final screen. requestStopLearning does not inspect the returned response. The final screen says adjustment has completed, retains the buzzer notice, disables Next and enables Setup complete. Setup complete emits backToUtilityMenu, with no further local communication operation.

If the polling loop exits without completion, the controller ends the session and shows the adjustment-failed dialog; it does not requestStopLearning. Any exception within the learning-screen try block causes another awaited endExtendSession and then the communication-error dialog; fulfillment of that dialog promise displays the initial screen. There is no finally block, cancellation token, timeout abort, or disposal check.

Setup complete on the setup screen opens the loader, awaits endExtendSession, closes the loader and returns to the initial screen. Exit on the initial screen asks 'Do you want to exit the Slope 0 Point Adjustment?'; pressed.id === 'No' does nothing, and any other fulfilled button result emits backToUtilityMenu. The adjustment-failed dialog returns to the initial screen on any fulfilled button result.

endExtendSession requests transitSession({modeId:1}), stopKeepAlive() with no argument, then endGeneralComm({}); each operation's promise rejection is individually swallowed. No additional ECU behavior is inferred. Controller disposal only calls currentView.disposeView() and eventDisp.dispose(), then resolves; it does not stop learning, end the session, close dialogs, clear state, or cancel an already running async workflow.

The worker API sends seven exact vc_06.* command strings through the separately owned GtsWorkerApi. Worker registration is guarded by absence of workerController.workerModels['Vc06']; initialization installs handlers bound with the model as their first argument. Browser model parameters are wrapped by the external dispatcher into the worker's observed param.parameter shape. This unit does not implement that transport wrapper.

Resource interpretations are supplied English text, not evidence that a buzzer, server transaction, vehicle-condition check, native command, or physical adjustment actually completed. Corrected common constant definitions and all referenced English resource labels are supplied and recorded. Shared framework implementation is available cross-owner at diagnostic_operations.frontend_contracts.MenuShell; gts.common runtime/native implementations likewise have separate owners rather than missing-source status. Local numeric predicates and request arrays remain exact.

semantics: Assigns Hncom01.RESULT the result of Object.freeze on the object {SUCCESS:0,FAILURE:1}. Both values are numbers.

SUCCESS is exact numeric 0. Vc06Controller.onClickSVc06001ViewStartBtn compares resultCertification.result with this value using ===; string '0', null, undefined, numeric 1 and other nonmatching values do not satisfy the predicate.
FAILURE is exact numeric 1. Vc06 does not separately compare against FAILURE: all nonmatching success values use its security-unlock error branch.
Object.freeze applies to this two-property result object; it does not establish certification outcomes or freeze the enclosing Hncom01 object.

semantics: Initializes slopeStatusList={}. In try, sequentially awaits sendMessage_readSlopeZeroPointAdjustmentValue(), sendMessage_readGradientAtOnly(), and sendMessage_readSlopeZeroPointLearningState(); returns Promise.resolve({slopeStatusList:slopeStatusList}). catch(error) returns Promise.reject() without reason.

Nested adjustment helper constructs para={reqType:0,reqBody:[0x22,0x12,0x82]} and returns gts.util.SendMessageForUtility(para).then(response => ...).catch(...). The then reads response.apiArgs.resBody. If resBody.length < 4 it returns Promise.reject(); otherwise chkResBody=resBody.slice(para.reqBody.length), assigns slopeStatusList['1282']=Number.parseFloat((chkResBody[0] * 2 - 160) / 100).toFixed(1), and returns Promise.resolve(). Its catch assigns slopeStatusList={} and returns Promise.reject().

Nested gradient helper constructs para={reqType:0,reqBody:[0x22,0x12,0x80]}. Its then reads response.apiArgs.resBody; if resBody.length < 4 it throws new Error(); otherwise chkResBody=resBody.slice(para.reqBody.length), assigns slopeStatusList['1280']=(chkResBody[0] - 100).toString(), and resolves. Its catch assigns slopeStatusList['1280']='' and returns Promise.resolve(), deliberately making this read optional.

Nested learning-state helper constructs para={reqType:0,reqBody:[0x22,0x1B,0x62]}. Its then reads response.apiArgs.resBody; if resBody.length < 5 it returns Promise.reject(); otherwise chkResBody=resBody.slice(para.reqBody.length), bitMask=0x80, and sets slopeStatusList['1B62']=1 if (chkResBody[1] & bitMask) === bitMask, else 0, then resolves. Its catch resets slopeStatusList={} and rejects without reason.

entry_admission.initialization: Vc07Controller.init constructs the model, view factory and dialog factory, logs the title, and returns the worker initialization chain before displaying S_VC-07-001.
entry_admission.setup: Start setup requires successful general communication and modeId 3 transition; keep-alive rejection is ignored. Editing additionally requires DID support strictly true, subtraction support strictly true, and certification result strictly equal to Hncom01.RESULT.SUCCESS, which is numeric 0.
entry_admission.write: The controller admits writing only when validation comResult is strictly equal to Vc07.ERROR_STATUS.ERROR_NONE, numeric 0. Worker validation requires a nonempty requested value within 35..180 and a cached-standard-minus-requested difference within 1..145, using JavaScript coercion.

guarded_ordered_transitions: Initialize worker cache, then render the initial screen.
Start setup: show loader; startGeneralComm; attempt startKeepAlive; transitSession({modeId:3}); request 0101, 1200, 2100 support in order.

Only strict DID support true permits the 2180 support read; only bit 0x80 support permits certification; only certification result 0 permits the standard-limit read followed by current-limit read and setup rendering.
Unsupported results end the session before displaying the unsupported screen. Certification non-success ends the session before the security dialog.

Post: show loader; obtain evt.args[1]; await validation outside the write try; on result 0 write cached subtraction plus attachment, await wait(100), reread current limit, update didValues, log success, close loader, recreate setup.

Invalid resolved validation closes the loader and shows the range dialog; acknowledgement recreates setup. Read/setup and write/readback catches end the session before closing the loader and showing the ECU error; acknowledgement then signals navigation through a detached chain.
Setup complete shows loader, awaits ordered teardown, closes loader and signals backToUtilityMenu. Unsupported-screen exit signals navigation without another teardown.

request_construction.worker_commands: See member_contracts for Vc07WorkerApi commands and worker initCommandHandler: nine exact vc_07 routes with unmodified parameter objects.

response_error_mapping.support: parsePhase5Support(response.apiArgs) must report truthy isSupport for 0x1201 and 0x1202, then 0x2180. A nullish parser yields unsupported. Resolved unsupported 1200 does not suppress 2100. The frontend subsequently requires strict true.
response_error_mapping.reads: Read helpers reject length < 4, otherwise slice response.apiArgs.resBody at request length 3. Only the first payload element is returned as the speed/support value; subtraction support also caches the remaining payload elements.
response_error_mapping.validation: Valid ranges cache subtraction and return {comResult:0}; either invalid range clears subtraction and returns {comResult:1}. Envelope/cache errors reject with their error because this method has no catch.
response_error_mapping.certification: result.result === 0 permits reads. Any resolved non-success shows the security-unlock error after teardown. Rejection follows the outer communication-error path.
response_error_mapping.transport_and_cleanup: Most worker read/write/start catches reject without a reason. Startup keep-alive rejection is swallowed. Teardown swallows each ordinary promise rejection separately; synchronous throws can interrupt it.
response_error_mapping.controller: See the full per-method semantics for nested versus outer catches, validation outside try, detached dialog/screen promises, and cleanup rejection interruption. There is no finally.

business_sequence: This unit implements the frontend workflow titled “Speed Limiter Max Speed Setting” (r_item_i6381). The supplied constants section conditionally declares an empty Vc07 function when Vc07 === undefined. Vc07.ERROR_STATUS is Object.freeze({ERROR_NONE:0,ERROR_EXIST:1}); Hncom01.RESULT is Object.freeze({SUCCESS:0,FAILURE:1}).

Controller initialization constructs the local model, view factory and dialog factory with commonInfo, logs the utility title, awaits worker-backed initialization using commonInfo.getCurrentEcuId(), and then displays S_VC-07-001. Initialization failures are delegated to inherited onErrorCommon through an unbound catch callback.

The initial screen displays empty current, change-limit and change-value rows in km/h, explanation and notice resources, an enabled Start setup button, a disabled Post button and an enabled Exit button. Exit opens a Yes/No confirmation; only pressed.id === 'No' cancels navigation.

Start setup opens the Please wait loader, starts general communication, attempts keep-alive, and transitions to modeId 3 in that order. Rejected keep-alive is deliberately ignored; rejected general communication or session transition propagates. It then sends support requests [0x22,0x01,0x01], [0x22,0x12,0x00] and [0x22,0x21,0x00] in order. Required support entries are exactly [0x1201,0x1202] and [0x2180]. A resolved unsupported result from the 1200 request does not skip the 2100 request.

Only resultDidSupport.isSupported === true admits the subtraction-support read [0x22,0x21,0x80]. The worker saves all payload elements after the first as subtractionAttachRawData and returns the first as resultRawData. The frontend model admits support only when (result.resultRawData & 0x80) === 0x80. Either unsupported branch ends the extended session, closes the loader and displays the unsupported screen.

When both support checks pass, a separate-owner Hncom01Controller(commonInfo) performs toolCertification(). Only resultCertification.result === Hncom01.RESULT.SUCCESS, numeric 0, admits editing. A resolved non-success ends the session, closes the loader, and presents the security-unlock error; acknowledgement does not navigate away.

After successful certification, didValues is reset to {'1201':null,'1202':null}. The standard-limit read [0x22,0x12,0x01] completes before the current-limit read [0x22,0x12,0x02]. Their first payload elements become didValues['1201'] and didValues['1202'], respectively. The standard value is also cached in the worker for validation. The loader closes and the setup screen displays parseInt(value,10) values, a new-value text input, enabled Post, and enabled Setup complete.

Input listeners suppress filtering during composition, then remove non-digits, remove all leading zeroes and retain at most three characters. This is UI filtering, not a replacement for worker validation. Posting forwards the actual input value through the event dispatcher; the controller reads evt.args[1] and sends {userSpecifiedSpeed} to validation.

Worker admission requires userSpecifiedSpeed !== '', userSpecifiedSpeed >= 35 and userSpecifiedSpeed <= 180, using JavaScript's existing comparison/coercion behavior. It computes cachedStandardLimit - userSpecifiedSpeed and additionally requires that difference to be between 1 and 145 inclusive. Success caches the subtraction and returns ERROR_NONE (0); every invalid branch clears the cached subtraction and returns ERROR_EXIST (1). The resources warn that actual vehicle minima vary from 35 to 50 km/h, but this unit's validation lower bound is exactly 35.

On validation ERROR_NONE (0), the worker sends {reqType:0,reqBody:[0x2E,0x21,0x80].concat(cacheData.subtractionValue,cacheData.subtractionAttachRawData)}. A resolved send is sufficient; this unit does not inspect the write response. The controller then awaits gts.util.wait(100), rereads the current limit, updates didValues['1202'], logs the exact resource text “This utility is successful”, closes the loader and recreates the setup screen. It neither compares the readback with the requested value nor ends the session on this success path.

On a resolved validation result not equal to ERROR_NONE (0), the loader closes and the range-error dialog appears. Acknowledgement recreates the setup screen with existing didValues and an empty new input. A rejection during validation itself is outside the write handler's try block and receives no local cleanup.

Read/setup or write/readback failures handled by the inner catches end the extended session, close the loader, show the ECU communication error with Key ON / Engine OFF instructions, then navigate back only after acknowledgement. The outer start catch ends the session, closes the loader and invokes inherited showCommErrorDialog(). Cleanup awaits can themselves reject and interrupt subsequent cleanup; there is no finally.

Setup complete opens the loader, awaits endExtendSession(), closes the loader and triggers backToUtilityMenu. The unsupported screen exits directly without another session-end call. Ordinary rejected promises from the three worker teardown operations are swallowed individually, allowing modeId 1 transition, stopKeepAlive() and endGeneralComm({}) to be attempted in order.

There is no local polling loop, interval, timer reschedule or timer-clear mechanism. The only explicit delay is await gts.util.wait(100). Controller disposal disposes currentView and its own event dispatcher only; it does not end communication, cancel pending asynchronous operations, dispose the model, or close dialogs.

semantics: Before try, constructs new GtsPFApi() and reads cacheData=model.cache.data.
Try awaits nested startGeneralComm(), then startKeepAlive(), then transitSession(); resolves without payload. Catch(error) rejects without a reason.
startGeneralComm builds {ecuId:cacheData.ecuInfo.ecuId,busId:cacheData.ecuInfo.busId}; returns gtsPFApi.startGeneralComm(para).then(()=>Promise.resolve()).catch(()=>Promise.reject()).
startKeepAlive builds {}; returns gtsPFApi.startKeepAlive(para).then(()=>Promise.resolve()).catch(()=>Promise.resolve()).

branches: Rejected startGeneralComm prevents keep-alive and transition.

semantics: Declares targetDidList1200=[0x1201,0x1202], targetDidList2100=[0x2180], isSupported=true.

Try awaits sendMessage_confirmSupportDid0101(), then sendMessage_confirmSupportDid1200(); sets isSupported=false if !resultDid1200.isSupported; then still awaits sendMessage_confirmSupportDid2100() and similarly records false. Resolves {isSupported:isSupported}. Catch(error) rejects without a reason.
0101 helper sends gts.util.SendMessageForUtility({reqType:0,reqBody:[0x22,0x01,0x01]}). Any resolved response is ignored and converted to {}; catch(response) rejects without preserving response.

1200 helper sends {reqType:0,reqBody:[0x22,0x12,0x00]}; its then calls gts.util.parsePhase5Support(response.apiArgs). For each did of [0x1201,0x1202], if !parser1200?.isSupport(did), immediately resolves {isSupported:false}. If all pass, resolves {isSupported:true}. Its catch(response) rejects without a reason.

2100 helper sends {reqType:0,reqBody:[0x22,0x21,0x00]}; its then calls gts.util.parsePhase5Support(response.apiArgs), tests each did of [0x2180] with !parser2100?.isSupport(did), and resolves false on failure or true after the loop. Catch(response) rejects without a reason.
branches: Nullish parser causes unsupported through optional chaining, not a successful support result.
A falsy isSupport result is unsupported; no strict boolean true requirement inside the helper.
A thrown parser/isSupport error reaches the helper catch, then the outer catch.
A rejected request stops the remaining sequence; a resolved unsupported request does not.
methods.effects_and_cleanup: No cache mutation, raw-response validation or cleanup in this member.

methods.semantics: Reads cacheData=model.cache.data. Tests param.parameter.userSpecifiedSpeed !== '' && param.parameter.userSpecifiedSpeed >= 35 && param.parameter.userSpecifiedSpeed <= 180. If admitted, computes subtractionValue=cacheData.userCustomStandardSpeedLimitRawData - param.parameter.userSpecifiedSpeed; tests subtractionValue >= 1 && subtractionValue <= 145. Success stores cacheData.subtractionValue=subtractionValue and resolves {comResult:Vc07.ERROR_STATUS.ERROR_NONE}, exactly {comResult:0}. Either failed range test stores cacheData.subtractionValue=null and resolves {comResult:Vc07.ERROR_STATUS.ERROR_EXIST}, exactly {comResult:1}.
branches: Exactly empty string is explicitly excluded; no type test or integer test.
Comparison and subtraction use JavaScript coercion, with no parseInt or trimming.
A requested speed equal to the cached standard is invalid because difference 0 is excluded.
No try/catch; envelope/cache/property errors reject the async method with their error.

semantics: Reads cacheData=model.cache.data before try. Try awaits sendMessage_writeSubtraction(), then resolves without payload; catch(error) rejects without a reason.

branches: Resolved transport response is ignored, regardless of its fields.
There is no local guard against null/stale subtractionValue or empty attachment data.
methods.effects_and_cleanup: No cache clear after write. concat supplies the scalar subtraction followed by attachment array elements under ordinary Array.concat behavior; no byte conversion or masking is added.

semantics: Constructs new GtsPFApi(); sequentially awaits nested transitSession(), stopKeepAlive(), endGeneralComm(); resolves without payload.
transitSession calls gtsPFApi.transitSession({modeId:1}).then(()=>Promise.resolve()).catch(()=>Promise.resolve()).
stopKeepAlive calls gtsPFApi.stopKeepAlive() with no argument, then converts either fulfillment or rejection to Promise.resolve().
endGeneralComm calls gtsPFApi.endGeneralComm({}), then converts either fulfillment or rejection to Promise.resolve().
branches: Ordinary rejected promises from each operation are swallowed, so later operations continue.
There is no encompassing try/catch; a synchronous throw before a returned chain is established can interrupt subsequent teardown and reject the async method.
methods.effects_and_cleanup: Does not reset worker cache, commandHandler or stored references. No explicit keep-alive timer is owned here.

resource_binding.presentation_source: Unit view/dialog methods construct inline DOM or supply typed content/button/table parameters to shared UtilityView/createCommonDialog; no external workflow HTML template path is referenced by these members. Exact inline HTML and options are preserved in source evidence.

entry_admission.initialization_gate: The seat-selection screen is displayed only after model.initSeat06() fulfills and title logging succeeds; rejection from that chain is passed to the bare inherited onErrorCommon reference.
entry_admission.operating_conditions: Engine/power switch ON with Engine OFF/Ready OFF is an operator instruction, not a locally queried or enforced admission condition.
entry_admission.seat_admission: Driver Seat is 0 and Passenger Seat is 1. Next is initially disabled exactly for selectedMode === -1. Next converts evt.args[1][0].value with Number without validating membership or numeric validity.
entry_admission.activation_admission: The checkbox click callback enables Start for at least one globally checked checkbox and disables unchecked checkboxes at a global count of at least two. The Start handler independently performs no selection-count, mode, model-compatibility, concurrency, or physical-condition validation.
entry_admission.worker_registration: The worker definition and registration block executes only when workerController.workerModels['Seat06'] is falsy.

selected_mode.interpretation: Strict equality to 0 selects the driver label; all other values select the passenger label in the bladder screen and Start log. The controller stores Number-converted Next input without membership checks; the worker places the supplied selectedMode unchanged into reqBody[6].

event_shapes.start: evt.args[1] is consumed as an array; truthy box.value retains box.domId as a selection key.
event_shapes.confirmation: dialog.buttonPressed fulfills with an object whose id is tested against 'Yes' and 'No'.

worker_payloads.worker_envelope: Worker handlers consume payload fields under param.parameter.

input_domain.invalid_or_unusual_inputs: Zero selections, duplicate keys, more than two keys, unmatched modes, and truthy nonboolean checkbox values have the exact branch behavior recorded in the method contracts. Malformed events and unknown controller keys can fail before the controller try; unknown worker keys fail inside sendMessage and enter worker recovery.

order: Initialize worker with current ECU ID.
Create seat-selection screen and register Next/Exit listeners.

Create or reuse the buttonless loader.
Await general communication startup and mode 1.
Attempt mode 1, suppressing its normal promise rejection.
Log success and return loader close.

order: Reject with {} if that recovery attempt completes.
Model awaits endGeneralComm and rejects with a new {} if cleanup fulfills.
Controller closes loader, awaits showCommErrorDialog(), then returns to seat selection.
guarded_ordered_transitions.qualification: These are sequential catch steps, not finally blocks; recovery failures can replace the intended rejection or prevent later actions. Full pre-try and synchronous-throw distinctions are retained in the method contracts.

order: Create confirmation with auto-closing Yes and No buttons.
No resolves without navigation; unknown IDs fall through.
guarded_ordered_transitions.qualification: Exit does not locally stop communication, dispose the controller, or cancel in-flight work.

request_construction.initialization: {ecuId: commonInfo.getCurrentEcuId()} is forwarded through seat_06.initSeat06 and read as param.parameter.ecuId.
session_requests: {modeId:1} for activation restoration on success or caught failure

reqBody: sum of selected byte-0 entry numbers, starting at 0x00
sum of selected byte-1 entry numbers, starting at 0x80
activation.representation: A plain object containing a JavaScript array, not a locally constructed typed array.
activation.selection_arithmetic: Two separate map/filter/map traversals use item.byte === 0 and item.byte === 1; each reduce uses pre + cur. There is no OR, deduplication, normalization, local coercion, range check, or local selection-count enforcement.
activation.concrete_seat_values: Normal Driver Seat requests use reqBody[6]=0; normal Passenger Seat requests use reqBody[6]=1. DEFAULT is -1, and no worker predicate prevents an externally supplied unmatched mode.

response_error_mapping.response_predicates: No local native or utility response object fields or response bytes are inspected, and physical activation is not verified locally.
response_error_mapping.startup: Native startGeneralComm and initial mode-1 transition discard fulfillment and rejection payloads; the worker maps caught failures to rejection with {}.
response_error_mapping.extended_session: Mode-3 transition discards payloads and maps caught failures to rejection with {}.
response_error_mapping.activation: SendMessageForUtility fulfillment and rejection payloads are discarded. Success returns {}; caught failure attempts mode 1 then rejects with {}. A normal rejecting mode-1 promise is converted to fulfillment on both paths.
response_error_mapping.shutdown: Normal native endGeneralComm promise rejection is suppressed and worker cleanup fulfills with {}; pre-call cache errors and synchronous invocation errors can still reject.
response_error_mapping.model: Caught failures await endGeneralComm, then reject with a fresh {}; cleanup rejection escapes instead. Failure of success-path shutdown causes a second shutdown attempt.
response_error_mapping.controller: Errors caught after entering Start's try cause awaited loader close, awaited inherited communication-error dialog, then seat-screen navigation. Pre-try label/event/logging errors bypass this recovery.
response_error_mapping.initialization: The attached catch uses the bare inherited onErrorCommon reference. Pre-chain synchronous errors become async rejection without entering that attached catch.

user_visible_result.title: Refresh Bladder Activation Check
user_visible_result.screens: Seat selection offers Driver Seat and Passenger Seat; bladder selection displays the selected seat and the thirteen resolved bladder labels in the four specified lines.
user_visible_result.success: Logs 'This operation is successful.' and closes the loader without changing screens or resetting selections. This denotes local promise-sequence success, not independently verified physical bladder behavior.
user_visible_result.failure: After loader close and the inherited communication-error dialog fulfill, returns to seat selection with the selected mode preserved.
user_visible_result.selection_log: Prefix is exactly 'Selected Seat and Bladder:' with no inserted following space before the seat label; a space separates seat and first bladder. Exactly two labels are comma-separated with no space after the comma. Other counts log only the first label, including undefined for zero.

mutation_cleanup_cancel_semantics.loader: Cached while truthy. closeLoaderDialog calls close without awaiting or forwarding its result, then nulls the reference only if close returns synchronously.
mutation_cleanup_cancel_semantics.communication_cleanup: Model cleanup is catch-based and sequential, not finally-based. The worker's native shutdown promise rejection is suppressed, but synchronous failures can propagate and affect later recovery.
mutation_cleanup_cancel_semantics.cancellation: No local abort signal, cancellation flag, timer handle, wait cancellation, response polling, Start reentry lock, or exit-triggered communication shutdown exists.
mutation_cleanup_cancel_semantics.disposal: Controller dispose unconditionally calls currentView.disposeView(), then eventDisp.dispose(), then returns Promise.resolve(). Missing currentView or a throwing view disposer prevents later steps. It does not close loader, dispose dialog factory or worker API, clear waits, or issue native cleanup.
mutation_cleanup_cancel_semantics.shared_event_semantics: The shared EventDispatcher accepts undefined event types using the same coerced property for registration and triggering. An undefined event value is not by itself evidence of nondelivery; listeners sharing such a key can share delivery.

business_sequence: The unit implements the frontend workflow titled “Refresh Bladder Activation Check”. The first screen instructs the operator to have the engine/power switch ON with Engine OFF/Ready OFF, select a seat, and press Next. These operating conditions are instructional text only: the local code does not query or enforce them.

Controller initialization constructs the model, view factory, and dialog factory, sets selectedModeNumber to Seat06.SELECTED_MODE.DEFAULT (-1), and initializes the worker with {ecuId: commonInfo.getCurrentEcuId()}. On initialization fulfillment it logs the title and displays the seat-selection screen. Initialization rejection and errors thrown in its fulfillment callback are passed to the inherited onErrorCommon callback.

The first screen offers Driver Seat (0) and Passenger Seat (1), with radio DOM IDs Seat06_radioBtn_0 and Seat06_radioBtn_1. Next is initially disabled exactly when the selected mode strictly equals DEFAULT (-1). The Next handler reads Number(evt.args[1][0].value), stores it without further validation, and opens bladder selection. Returning from bladder selection preserves this selected mode.

The bladder-selection screen groups CHECK_BOX_VALUE entries into four lines: BR1/BR2/BR3/BR4, BL1/BL2/BL3/BL4, B5, and C1/C2/C3/C4. Each label is the key followed by ' Bladder', using the authoritative resolved resource IDs. The instructions permit up to two selections and warn that installed bladders vary by vehicle model. No model-specific filtering is implemented locally. Every rendered checkbox starts unchecked.

Checkbox clicks count all checked checkbox elements in the document, disable all unchecked checkboxes when that count is at least two, and enable Start when the count is at least one. These are global DOM selectors rather than selectors scoped to this view. The Start handler itself does not enforce a one-to-two selection limit.

Start filters evt.args[1] by truthy box.value, extracts box.domId, resolves those keys through CHECK_BOX_VALUE, and logs the selected seat and bladder labels. Exactly two labels produce a two-label comma-separated log; every other count logs only the first label. Mapping and logging occur before the handler's try block.

Inside the Start try block, the controller creates or reuses a buttonless “Please wait.” loader, then awaits model.activateRefreshBladder({selectedMode: selectedModeNumber, selectedCheckBoxValue: selectedCheckBoxValue}). The model sequentially awaits general communication startup, extended-session startup, activation, and communication shutdown.

Worker general-communication startup calls GtsPFApi.startGeneralComm({ecuId: cached ecuInfo.ecuId, busId: cached ecuInfo.busId}), then GtsPFApi.transitSession({modeId:1}). Extended-session startup subsequently calls transitSession({modeId:3}). Results are interpreted only by promise fulfillment or rejection, not by inspecting returned fields.

Activation constructs reqBody [0x31,0x01,0x12,0x49,byte0,byte1,selectedMode,0x05] with reqType 0. byte0 is the arithmetic sum of selected byte-0 entry numbers starting at 0x00; byte1 is the arithmetic sum of selected byte-1 entry numbers starting at 0x80. Normal seat values are 0 for driver and 1 for passenger. The code does not OR, normalize, deduplicate, range-check, or coerce these values locally.

After SendMessageForUtility fulfills, activation awaits gts.util.wait(5000), attempts transitSession({modeId:1}), and awaits gts.util.wait(3000), then fulfills with {}. Rejection of that session-transition promise is deliberately converted to fulfillment. There is no response-byte predicate, polling loop, recurring timer, or local cancellation mechanism.

On activation failure inside its try block, the worker attempts the same mode-1 transition and then rejects with {}. The model catch awaits endGeneralComm and rejects with a new {} if cleanup fulfills. The controller catch closes the loader, awaits inherited showCommErrorDialog(), and returns to the seat-selection screen. These are sequential awaits, not finally blocks; a cleanup rejection can prevent later recovery steps.

On model success the controller logs “This operation is successful.” and returns closeLoaderDialog(). The bladder-selection screen remains current, with its existing checkboxes and DOM state; there is no success-screen transition or selection reset.

Exit on either screen opens the confirmation “Do you want to exit the Refresh Bladder Activation Check Utility?” with auto-closing Yes and No buttons. Yes triggers backToUtilityMenu; No resolves without changing the screen. The exit path itself does not shut down communication, dispose the controller, or cancel an in-flight operation.

Controller disposal disposes the current view and its own event dispatcher and returns a resolved promise. It does not guard against a missing current view, close the loader, dispose the dialog factory, dispose the worker API, clear waits, or issue native cleanup.

inputs.detail: Actual #v_c_pane hierarchy, generated input/button nodes, click/composition/input events, input values and external view disposal outcomes exist at runtime.

inputs.input: Logging and delay outcomes
inputs.detail: Concrete logging side effects or synchronous failures and gts.util.wait(100) fulfillment/rejection are runtime outcomes. Logger return values are ignored.

inputs.input: Runtime commonInfo and ECU metadata
inputs.boundary: Current ECU identifier, getEcuInfoByEcuId results, and concrete ecuId/busId values are runtime data. The exact fields consumed and the cache reference assignment are specified in the method and handoff contracts.

inputs.input: Operator and DOM events
inputs.boundary: Selected radio values, checkbox event payloads, confirmation pressed.id, and unrelated document checkboxes are runtime inputs. Their Number conversion, truthiness filtering, global counting, and branch interpretations are specified locally.

inputs.input: Native, ECU, backend, transport, and common utility settlements
inputs.boundary: Concrete promise fulfillment/rejection outcomes and values from GtsPFApi, SendMessageForUtility, worker transport, and shared dialogs occur at runtime. The local code's ignored fields, rejection replacement, suppression, forwarding, and await ordering are specified without inventing external results.

inputs.input: Timing and physical bladder behavior
inputs.boundary: The actual elapsed time, external timer scheduling, physical inflation/deflation, installed bladder availability, and operator observations are runtime facts. Local code requests sequential waits of 5000 and 3000 and does not verify physical activation.

inputs.input: Shared runtime objects and callback results
inputs.boundary: Concrete view/dialog instances, buttonPressed settlement, inherited error-handler results, event delivery, navigation listeners, logger failures, and close/disposal invocation outcomes are runtime inputs governed by the available separate owners. Exact consumed interfaces are retained in cross_owner_handoffs.

inputs.input: Worker registry and initialization state
inputs.boundary: The existing truthiness of workerController.workerModels['Seat06'], worker init arguments, cache state, command envelopes, and interleaving from repeated Start/Exit actions are runtime state. The local registration guard, field mutations, and absence of reentry/cancellation guards are specified.
